pages.title: Shiftnote - Staff scheduling for independent restaurants
pages.description: Build next week's rota in 10 minutes. Staff swap shifts from their phones, you approve.
headings: Shift swaps without the group chat
pages.text: The rota, done in 10 minutes. Drag shifts onto next week, copy last week, and publish to every phone. Staff ask to swap and you approve with one tap, so the group chat stays quiet. Each schedule shows the labour cost against your sales forecast. Made for independent restaurants and cafés with 8 to 60 staff.

pages.title: Pricing - Shiftnote
pages.text: Simple pricing. $29 per location per month, any number of staff. Free for 30 days.
